To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) we introduce a novel framework, DialSQL, that leverages human interaction to improve the performance of a black-box structured query generation algorithm; (ii) DialSQL achieves state-ofthe- art performance on the WikiSQL benchmark dataset.
(i) DialSQL is a dialogue based structured query generation framework; (ii) it leverages human intelligence via user interaction to boost the performance.

1) DialSQL, a framework that leverages user interaction to boost the performance, 2) DialSQL improves the performance of SQLNet from 61.4% to 69% using only 4.8 validation questions per dialogue, 3) DialSQL is capable to identify potential errors in the generated SQL query and ask users for validation via multi-choice questions.

the following questions: How to leverage human intelligence to improve the performance of existing query generation tools? How to design effective user interfaces to facilitate user validation of SQL queries?
